scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/conhecimento/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/dominio/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/tsconfig.json
scripts.verificar: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run validar-conhecimento
scripts.ingest:menu: cd ingest && TRANSCRIPT_NORMALIZER_HOME="$PWD" uv run --locked --project ../tools/ingest transcript-normalizer
scripts.ingest:video: cd ingest && TRANSCRIPT_NORMALIZER_HOME="$PWD" uv run --locked --project ../tools/ingest transcript-normalizer fetch --keep-raw --keep-audio
scripts.ingest:info: cd ingest && TRANSCRIPT_NORMALIZER_HOME="$PWD" uv run --locked --project ../tools/ingest transcript-normalizer fetch --list
scripts.ingest:lista: cd ingest && TRANSCRIPT_NORMALIZER_HOME="$PWD" uv run --locked --project ../tools/ingest transcript-normalizer list
scripts.ingest:normalizar: cd ingest && TRANSCRIPT_NORMALIZER_HOME="$PWD" uv run --locked --project ../tools/ingest transcript-normalizer normalize
scripts.ingest:revisar: cd ingest && TRANSCRIPT_NORMALIZER_HOME="$PWD" uv run --locked --project ../tools/ingest transcript-normalizer normalize --review
scripts.ingest:propor: cd ingest && TRANSCRIPT_NORMALIZER_HOME="$PWD" uv run --locked --project ../tools/ingest transcript-normalizer pack propose --pack financas-ptbr
scripts.ingest:versao: cd ingest && TRANSCRIPT_NORMALIZER_HOME="$PWD" uv run --locked --project ../tools/ingest transcript-normalizer --version
